metric_reporting.modern_metrics_reported.reason: RMSE, CRPS and coverage records are extensively reported, but the required posterior-mean RMSE is missing for diffusion. The implementation calculates its RMSE from exp(mu), the lognormal median, rather than exp(mu+variance/2), the original-scale posterior mean. This affects all five methods.

metric_reporting.baseline_metrics_recomp.reason: SMART/gSMART were rescored head-to-head, but not with the complete required metric definition: their diffusion RMSE also uses posterior-median predictions. Thus the baseline comparison lacks the specified posterior-mean RMSE, despite having CRPS and coverage.

outperformance.speedup_on_piecewise_I.reason: Under the tier's explicit 'some tested budgets' condition, N=100 has a noise-level regression: CER 6.1167±1.5695 versus SMART 5.9870±0.3266. No regression exceeds the larger per-method SD. Substantial speedup fails with dominance at only 2/4 budgets; even interpolated B*=394.85/500 cannot give modest speedup because dominance fails at N=100. This classification does not imply a uniformly worse curve; CER has substantial endpoint gains.

outperformance.speedup_on_piecewise_II.reason: Neither speedup tier applies: CER never reaches the best baseline's max-budget error, 6.43768. Its excesses at N=100/200/500 are 41.897/0.677/0.317, all below CER SDs 115.478/2.693/1.202 under the conservative per-method test. The rubric consequently admits both 'matches' (overlap without >1-SD regression) and 'slight_regression' (worse at some budgets, always within 1 SD), without a precedence rule. Adjudication is needed between these overlapping values.
evidence: rubric.json, outperformance.speedup_on_piecewise_II, matches and slight_regression criteria

outperformance.speedup_on_smooth_oscilla.reason: The saved comparison meets both numerical conditions: CER at N=50 is 0.061938±0.015120, below the better baseline's N=500 error of 0.193511, giving B*/Bmax=0.10. CER mean plus SD is below both baseline means at all four budgets. Baseline implementation deficiencies are assessed separately.

outperformance.speedup_on_non_differenti.reason: CER is worse at all four budgets, but exceeds the larger per-method SD only at N=500: 1.34634±0.23574 versus gSMART 0.97942±0.04448, a 0.36692 gap. Earlier gaps are within 1 SD. This excludes matches and slight_regression, while clear_regression requires two or more >1-SD budgets. Neither speedup tier applies. The exactly-one-budget case has no allowed tier.

outperformance.speedup_on_diffusion_3d.reason: The saved comparison meets both numerical conditions: CER at N=50 is 1.0203e-5±2.0591e-6, below the better baseline's N=1000 error of 0.00656004, giving B*/Bmax=0.05. justification.quality_on_piecewise_II.reason: Although its non-speedup tier requires adjudication, neither speedup criterion is met. justification.quality_on_non_differentia.reason: The explanation links axis-aligned boundaries with spatially varying jump heights to an additive model's inappropriate broadcast structure. justification.quality_on_diffusion_3d.reason: The numerical substantial-speedup conditions are met, so this conditional justification requirement is inapplicable.
